intro: Sudanese culture mixes Arab, Nubian and African traditions.

chapters.title: Music and writing
text: Sudanese music, with its five-note scale, is popular across East Africa. Tayeb Salih's Season of Migration to the North is a classic of Arabic literature.

chapters.title: Food
text: Ful medames, kisra flatbread and strong coffee called jebena are everyday staples.
